statement0:
The word "among" is mentioned in 23.6% of papers' Results sections, as of 2020-2024.

Among 2020-2024 papers containing "among" , 26.8% of reported significant p-values (p < .05) are fragile (.01 ≤ p < .05) - i.e., barely fall under the standard significance threshold. This rate is similar to median Psychology paper (shown in black); relative to other words, papers with "among" are in the top 52nd percentile of fragile p-value percentages. Note, strong/weak p-values highly predict replicability.
statement1: As of 2020-2024, papers containing "among" tend to be published in lower impact factor journals (33rd percentile among all words) but tend to be cited more (68th percentile word). In general, this word is negatively associated with university ranking, such that higher-ranked institutions are less likely to publish papers containing "among" (36th percentile).
